verdict.rationale: Logseq's first-party docs say it publishes a graph as a single-page web application, with no pages public by default and individual pages opted in via `publish:: true`. That covers publishing selected notes as a browsable site, and a community user explicitly praises the publishing features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that page/block links stay navigable in the published site, evidence that the whole flow (including hosting/deploy) happens without leaving the app, and detailed hands-on corroboration.
